name: modelmaker
description: Visual pipeline builder for financial model development: the Model-Maker canvas inside VS Code, with GitHub Copilot as its AI.

modelmaker.pythonPath.markdownDescription: Python interpreter that runs the Model-Maker backend. Empty: the interpreter selected in the Python extension, else `python3`/`python` on PATH.

modelmaker.autoInstall.markdownDescription: Whether to `pip install` the Model-Maker package into that interpreter when it's missing or too old.

modelmaker.packageSpec.markdownDescription: What `pip install -U` installs: a PyPI requirement (e.g. `quantology-modelmaker[anthropic]`), or a local path for development (e.g. `-e /path/to/Model-Maker`).

modelmaker.llm.useCopilot.markdownDescription: Offer your GitHub Copilot models to Model-Maker's AI features (drafting blocks, AI builds) and make Copilot the default provider. Other providers stay available in the canvas's Settings.

modelmaker.backend.extraEnv.markdownDescription: Extra environment variables for the backend process, e.g. `{"ANTHROPIC_API_KEY": "…"}`.

languageModelTools.name: modelmaker_get_graph
languageModelTools.modelDescription: The open Model-Maker project's pipeline: lanes, every block in run order (id, name, category, lane, status grey/green/orange/red/running, params, input and output ports as name:type, the error of a red block, why an orange block is stale) and every wire. Call this first, and again after edits.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read the open canvas's blocks, wires and statuses

languageModelTools.name: modelmaker_list_block_types
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Without a tag: the block tags (e.g. data_prep, sampling, pd, validation) with a description of each. With a tag: that tag's blocks (category id and one-sentence summary), built-ins and the user's library. Use describe_block_type before adding one.

tag.description: A tag from the tag list.

languageModelTools.name: modelmaker_describe_block_type
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Full documentation for one block category: what it does, its parameters (types, defaults, which ones auto-fill from a column role) and its input/output ports.

languageModelTools.name: modelmaker_get_output_summary
languageModelTools.modelDescription: A block's last output on one port (default: its first). For a dataframe: row count and each column's dtype, role, nulls, distinct count and mean/std/min/max -- never the rows. For a statistics table (binning summary, metric tables): its rows. For a metric or model: the value. The block must have run (green or orange).
languageModelTools.userDescription: Summarize a block's output (schema and statistics, not rows)

block.description: A block id (or exact name) from modelmaker_get_graph.

port.description: An output port name; default the first.

languageModelTools.name: modelmaker_add_block
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Adds a block to the canvas (it starts grey; wire its inputs with modelmaker_connect, then run it). Returns the new block with its id and ports.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Add a block to the canvas

category.description: The block category (from list/describe block types).

lane.description: Lane id or name to put it in.

params.description: Parameter values; omitted ones take their defaults.

languageModelTools.name: modelmaker_set_params
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Changes some of a block's parameters (merged into its current ones). Downstream blocks go stale until re-run.

block.description: A block id (or exact name) from modelmaker_get_graph.

params.description: The parameters to change, with their new values.

languageModelTools.name: modelmaker_connect
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Wires one block's output port to another block's input port (ports as listed by modelmaker_get_graph, without the :type suffix).

from_block.description: A block id (or exact name) from modelmaker_get_graph.

to_block.description: A block id (or exact name) from modelmaker_get_graph.

languageModelTools.name: modelmaker_run
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Runs a block and the blocks upstream of it, or with no block the whole pipeline (which also reads the data sources -- a single block's run doesn't), and waits for it. Returns status counts and each affected block's status, with the error of any red block.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Run the pipeline, or up to one block

block.description: A block id (or exact name) from modelmaker_get_graph.

languageModelTools.name: modelmaker_compile
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Compiles the pipeline into one self-contained, readable Python script and returns its source. Every block must be green.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Compile the pipeline to a Python script

streaming.description: Fuse compatible stretches into streaming polars queries.

scripts.test: npm run build && node esbuild.mjs --tests && vscode-test
